1) Close your game, close the launcher and close the server

2) On SPT mods folder, go to Valens AIO “config” folder and open “traders.json” file

3) On this file, change the line 4 from

“enabled”: true,

to

“enabled”: false,

4) Save the file

5) Start you game.

Doing this you will lose all the changes Valens AIO has made to the original traders, but you may keep Priscillu and others modded traders working.

Hope it solves the issue.

Good luck.

comments.body_html:
Hi,

It seems to be a compatibility issue with another mod.

Unfortunately, we can not do much about it, as some mods do not work well together. But If you want, you can try these fix for some well known compatibility issues:

1) When playing with SPT-Realism and Priscilu Trader, noticing only 2 or 3 weapon presets available and only a handfull of ammo.

Open your SPT Realism config .exe in your user/mods folder, then go to traders and the 3rd option should be “change item loyalty levels”. Turn that off, since it changes what items are available.

2) Any other compatibility issue between Priscilu Trader and SPT-Realism mod.

To fix this, we suggest you disable everything related to “traders” on SPT-Realism config. After that, try to enable each one at a time to discover what are the conflicting config parameters.

Obs.: although these fix have worked for some players, we can not guarantee they will work for all, once we do not play with these mods.

Finally, if none of these fix have worked, if you want to keep on trying, we suggest you turn off your game (server too), disable all other mods, turn on SPT-AKI and play the game just with Priscilu Trader installed. If everything is ok, turn off your game again, install one mod, turn on the game and play the game. If everything is ok, repeat the process, always installing one more mod after the game runs ok. Keep on doing this until the conflict happens. At this moment, you have found the conflicting mod. Now you can stop playing with this mod or try to change this mod config to find a way to avoid the conflict.

After that I hope the most elegant sloth of Tarkov appear on your game.
